slides.texte_overlay:
Manners every man under 25
should learn early

1. Wait until everyone is served
before you start eating.

2. Offer the front seat
to the oldest passenger.

3. Walk on the street side
of the sidewalk.

4. Stand up when you're introduced.
Every time.

5. Ask good questions
at dinner.
Know a little about a lot.
slides.texte_sophia:
5. Ask good questions at dinner.
I learn something new every day
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
6. Pay back small debts
the same day.

7. Say "thank you for having me"
when you leave.

8. Text when you got home safe.

9. Clear your plate
without being asked.
